# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: a moving script_brushmodel and three items.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_push), one client joined allies, 2026-10-06.
# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29211 SECS=75 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_push mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29211 --probe-items --probe-team allies --probe-secs 65
# The PROBE lines are the server half, unedited: each phase's start and one
# `PROBE f` line per server frame with the three items' origins and the brush
# model's getorigin(). The ITEM lines are the client half, unedited: each item
# entity's ground and trajectories on every snapshot it appeared or changed.
# docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 12, is what it measured; gated by
# crates/server/tests/push_ab.rs.
